Exactly two suite lines are permitted: the original named AnyHierarchyTests suite start then positive suite finish. Both selected starts/finishes must be contained between those boundaries.

Exactly one Test run with line must be the positive two-tests/one-suite summary after the suite finish. Exactly one run-start banner must precede the suite. Zero-test, other totals and extra run summaries cannot satisfy the predicate.

Any Test Case, Test Suite or Executed substring rejects the log. Any recognized Swift Testing method event outside the two exact names raises; unknown/failed/skipped/parameterized Test event forms raise. Additional suites or a total above two also reject. The four Host XCTest methods are additionally absent from the chosen Integration executable/product closure.

The caller requires direct child exit0 and original new-owned-group absence before parsing. Product/source witness equality and final original lifecycle/resource checks remain outside and after the parser. No old receipt is modified; missing-two PASS is separate from combined six-method acceptance.

limits: This is static inspection of actual source, not parser execution, a synthetic control, or observed test dispatch.
